title: OCEAN Fleet Manifest
description: Defines multiple targets for fleet-wide hardening with ocean harden --fleet.

description.description: Optional description of the fleet operation.

targets.description: List of targets to harden. Each target has its own credential context.

id.description: Unique target identifier. Used in output filenames and reporting.

source.description: Source system type. Determines which checks and credential allowlist apply.

credentials.description: Credential mappings. Values must use ${ENV_VAR_NAME} syntax for env var interpolation. Plaintext secrets are rejected.
